query_filter: NFKC then casefold; Chinese phrases substring; ASCII phrases matched with ASCII alphanumeric boundaries
selection: Sort eligible query hashes SHA256(seed + NUL + normalized query). Keep each entire query with all provided positive/negative passages; stop at 40 queries or before global unique passage count exceeds 1000. No selection based on retrieval outputs.
local_split: All are from the official dev source, never official test. Alternating selected normalized-query families in hash order into local dev/test; related/duplicate exact normalized queries stay together. Local test is held out from parameter tuning.
label_mapping: Published binary positive -> 1, negative -> 0. Original 4-level scores are unavailable here and will not be invented.
notes: Chinese web CS-topic supplement, not course lectures.
Positive and negative lists may not exhaust all relevant material outside the provided pool.
Corpus union adds unjudged cross-query pairs; keep explicit negative judgments distinct from unjudged.
